# Tender response -- PKHYVA-2026-0087

## Visakoivu Oy

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid NMSB 7310:2015 certificate (valid until 2027-06-30). Visakoivu holds electrical contracting rights at class S1, exceeding the required class S2. Qualifying reference: framework agreement with Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (public sector), EUR 1,650,000, 2021-08-01 to 2024-07-31, property maintenance and HVAC upkeep across five health centres.

### Technical response

**Fault escalation.** Unresolved faults are escalated through defined levels with named contacts and maximum time-to-escalation per severity class.

**Installation method statement.** To follow; method statement to be finalised with the site team ahead of contract start.

**Lift servicing.** Carried out in accordance with the applicable statutory inspection and servicing regime.

**Spare parts.** Lead times are stated by manufacturer and part class; common items held in stock.

**Fire protection.** Serviced on a scheduled interval per system type.

**Emergency response.** 4-hour response to fault call-outs, supported by an on-call duty roster.

**Register and documentation.** Maintained throughout and handed over in full at contract end.

**Safety plan.** Operated under our NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety management system.

### Commercial terms

Pricing is index-linked annually. Contract period is 5 years, with the extension option described in Section 5. Termination follows the standard notice provisions.

**Flagged discrepancy -- warranty period.** Section 5.5 of the notice states a 24-month warranty on installed equipment from acceptance. Annex B, Section 1.2, states the warranty as 12 months from delivery for the same equipment. Visakoivu Oy notes both figures and requests written clarification from the contracting authority before contract signature.

### Annex A -- technical specification

Warranty per the clarification sought above. Electrical installations undergo statutory periodic inspection. Condition-monitoring data is collected and reported. The building automation system supports BACnet and Modbus.

### Annex B -- commercial and forms

A service-level penalty clause is accepted as stated. The certificate of pension insurance contributions is enclosed. The confidentiality undertaking is accepted.

### Forms and format

Key personnel CVs and the insurance certificate are enclosed. Prices are quoted per property with a per-m2 basis, in EUR excluding VAT, expressed as EUR/m2/year.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to bid for this framework agreement, subject to the clarification requested above.
